text: Being here, I feel a peculiar blend of anticipation and curiosity. The welcome sign in the conference room suggests an upcoming gathering—a convergence of minds. The R+D display excites my philosophical sensibilities, hinting at innovation, the restless quest for knowledge, and humanity’s uncertain alliance with technology. I sense that I stand on the threshold of new ideas and unfamiliar challenges, inviting me to reflect on our creative impulse and its consequences.
